mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, name, color FROM tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY name
SELECT id, workspace_id, name, color FROM tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT id, workspace_id, name, color FROM tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND name = #{name}
SELECT id, workspace_id, name, color FROM tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND name LIKE #{query} ORDER BY name LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag (workspace_id, name, color) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{color})
mapper.update: UPDATE tag SET name = #{name}, color = #{color} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tag WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.name, t.color FROM tag t JOIN person_tag pt ON pt.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pt.person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY t.name
SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.name, t.color FROM tag t JOIN company_tag ct ON ct.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY t.name
SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.name, t.color FROM tag t JOIN deal_tag dt ON dt.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND dt.deal_id = #{dealId} ORDER BY t.name
SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.name, t.color FROM tag t JOIN attachment_tag at ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND at.attachment_id = #{attachmentId} ORDER BY t.name

choose.otherwise: SELECT t.id AS record_id, t.id AS tag_id, t.name FROM tag t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND 1 = 0

mapper.select: SELECT pt.person_id AS entityId, t.name AS name FROM person_tag pt JOIN person p ON p.id = pt.person_id JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.name

SELECT ct.company_id AS entityId, t.name AS name FROM company_tag ct JOIN company c ON c.id = ct.company_id JOIN tag t ON t.id = ct.tag_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.name
SELECT dt.deal_id AS entityId, t.name AS name FROM deal_tag dt JOIN deal d ON d.id = dt.deal_id JOIN tag t ON t.id = dt.tag_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY t.name
